visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a dimly lit outdoor evening setting, a woman with dark hair tied back wears a white short-sleeved top and matching white trousers. She stands next to a man in a dark green button-down shirt. A yellow and black caution tape is stretched across the foreground, held by individuals off-screen. (2) The woman begins to lean backward, performing a limbo dance. The man in the green shirt holds her hands firmly to provide stability and support. A large red circular cushion or beanbag is visible on the floor behind her, positioned as a safety measure. The background is filled with a cheering crowd under colorful stage lighting. (3) The woman leans exceptionally low, her torso almost parallel to the ground as she slowly shuffles her feet to move under the barrier tape. Her facial expression shows intense focus and a slight smile. The man leans with her, maintaining a steady grip on her hands. Colorful pink and blue lights illuminate the scene from above. (4) Successfully passing under the tape, the woman stands back up with a wide, triumphant smile. She and the man turn away from the barrier, walking toward a bar area where several glasses and bottles are visible on a counter. The crowd in the background continues to clap and cheer.
